message.content:
A vertical rectangular magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large red block letters at the top. The "M" is replaced by a stylized person with pale pink skin and dark hair, wearing a white shirt. This person stands inside a red and blue rectangular cart, holding a black telescope to their right eye. The cart sits atop a tall, gray, latticed steel structure resembling a roller coaster track. The track slants steeply downward to the right, forming a red zigzag line. Below the main title, smaller red text reads "E N... A D A N P E R L U". 

The background is a solid cream color. Text in the upper left says "Kepala Komunikasi Kepresidenan di Ujung Tanduk H.26" and in the upper right, "Tumpang-Tindih Penanganan Korupsi oleh Polisi H.34". A red "51" logo appears beside "TEMPO". Centered on the right is a small bar chart logo with "TEMPO x Celios Economic Review". Below this, bold black text reads "JEMAWA PANGKAL SENGSARA". A paragraph follows describing economic indicators and leadership styles, ending with "H.70". The bottom left contains a date "14-20 APRIL 2025", price, website, barcode, and QR code.
